text:
Elaine: quick q — the console alert card shows threshold + channels but no estimate for expected fanout/noise. ops teams keep getting surprised. can we surface estimated notifs/week per rule? :thinking:

Mike: 100% agree. Even a coarse number would help teams decide whether to lower sensitivity or add quiet windows.

Jiya: implementation note — computing a live, accurate fanout every render is expensive. we can precompute daily aggregates and cache. for ad-hoc what-if sims we can run a sampled estimator endpoint.

Ashley: UX idea: add a tiny 'impact preview' pill on the rule card with "~12/wk" and a chevron that expands to a channel breakdown + sparkline. also a preview mode that applies tenant overrides so owners can see who actually gets paged.

Mike: +1. also need a clear signal when a rule has per-tenant overrides or sticky routing that increases fanout — those are the shockers. maybe a tooltip: "this rule has 3 tenant overrides".

Jiya: API complication: current notify-preview endpoint returns routes but intentionally hides tenant weights. we could add `?include_tenant_weights=true` (cheap) or a body { "include_tenant_weights": true } for POST. either way it adds compute.

Elaine: can we avoid a new heavy endpoint? proposal: surface precomputed daily telemetry on the card (estimate + breakdown) and put a "Run live simulation" button that calls the heavier endpoint on demand. keeps main UX snappy.

Teresa (PM): from product POV — want both: precomputed expected notifications for quick triage and a live "what-if" for runbooks/rollouts. the what-if should explain assumptions (sampling rate, quiet windows, tenant weights).

Ashley: mock posted here: https://rwd-internal/figures/alert-impact-mock — shows compact number + expand for last 30d sparkline + "simulate" CTA. also includes an inline legend for quiet windows.

ops-bot: [monitor] precompute job finished for 17,255 rules; preview cache refreshed 12m ago.

Mike: rough infra plan: precompute pipeline (map-reduce over raw notifications -> per-rule weekly estimate + distribution by channel), store in telemetry service. UI reads that. simulation endpoint will re-run a sampled pipeline with current routing policy.

Jiya: caveat — sampling must respect tenant affinities; otherwise we under/overestimate noisy tenants. we'll need to fold in per-tenant weights from routing config or fallback to defaults.

Elaine: next steps: Mike + Jiya + Ashley sync tomorrow 10am to draft API shape + small UX copy. Teresa: can you prioritize this for the next console sprint? if anyone thinks this is duplicative, speak now. :eyes:
